scope: BazukaSchool course requirements; source media remains outside the public repository

requirements.request: One main course with lessons divided into sections, brief introduction, explanation, practice, notes and homework.
requirements.implementation: CourseWorkspace; section navigation, progress, notes, homework; two specified lessons

requirements.details: Original handout plus explicitly labelled newly authored explanations and exercises

requirements.request: Reading introduction + Passage 1 + complex structures + Speaking Family
requirements.details: New shorter fictional practice passage, not an official mock test; full original Family preserved

requirements.request: Separate articles area with exercises and questions; Language Boost Corner with audio and topical vocabulary
requirements.details: Two linked full original articles, worksheets, Family audio/video, speaking responses

requirements.request: Student audio answers with teacher feedback
requirements.constraint: One device and browser. Names are labels, not authenticated accounts; no remote synchronization

requirements.request: Topical vocabulary exercises, ideas, and examples of developed answers aimed at Band 8
requirements.details: 20 thematic coach models accessible from topic Practice; contextual exercises and annotated rewrites for Personality and Family; four criteria linked to IELTS; no automatic Band assignment

requirements.request: Five Writing topics also used for oral vocabulary and idea practice
requirements.details: All original prompts retained, each now has audio response practice
Peach, mint and lavender lesson cards; friendly course home; section navigation

requirements.request: Accept content by slide without requiring existing presentations; short videos with explanations and tasks
requirements.details: Each section accepts teacher text and HTTPS resource link, with inline YouTube or MP4 player. Actual new teacher lesson recordings have not been supplied. Local additions need code publication to appear for other browsers.

requirements.request: Ask how similar organisation can be made in Telegram
requirements.details: Topics in a group can separate announcements, lessons, homework and speaking. No target group supplied; no Telegram changes or messages made.

requirements.request: Where to record lessons; previously only Zoom considered
requirements.details: Reply video demonstrates Canva Present and record. Store short recordings per section; no recording of teacher created.
